mechanism_narrative: A declining Federal Funds Rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Unemployment Rate exceeds 5.5% for three consecutive months, it indicates economic weakness and triggers a risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in Federal Funds Rate and Unemployment Rate signals a strong economic recovery with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is absent when the joint decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE occurs, as evidenced by SPX 60-day returns being negative in over 55% of such cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong GDP growth and high housing starts signal overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods as defined by GDPC1 growth > 3.0% and HOUST > 1500, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery phases, strong job growth and declining unemployment signal sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of post-pandemic recovery periods as defined by PAYEMS growth > 100k and UNRATE decline > 0.5pp, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
